mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `quote_price_history` ( `product_id`, `quote_date`, `retail_price`, `distributor1_price`, `distributor2_price`, `create_time`, `update_time` ) VALUES ( #{productId}, #{quoteDate}, #{retailPrice}, #{distributor1Price}, #{distributor2Price}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE `retail_price` = VALUES(`retail_price`), `distributor1_price` = VALUES(`distributor1_price`), `distributor2_price` = VALUES(`distributor2_price`), `update_time` = VALUES(`update_time`)
